title: Church membership and attitudes toward musicians
summary: He attends churches as he likes, and objects to churches that make musicians quit playing.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Well, did she used to sing in the church?
Yeah, she used to sing in church. Did you ever sing in church?
Oh, yeah. What church did you belong to? Pilgrim Progress. You still go there?
No, no.
I go there and I'm not. You go to any church?
I go to Catholic, I go to Baptist, I go to anyone I feel like I want to go, I go.
Well, do you go to church every Sunday or just when you feel like you?
No, no, no, no, that don't make you be no Christian, going every Sunday.
You just go when you feel like going?
I go when I want to go.
You just go and attend service and… stuff
And listen, you're not a member of any particular church?
I'm not a member of nobody's church. I was going to join that church, see, being a musician, everybody will accept a musician in that church. You know? Some churches do, some churches don't.
Oh. You mean they don't like you just because you're a musician?

I'm a musician. So I said, well, if I've got a diabetic musician, I'm a diabetic musician. But see, Jack Willis, Alvin Alcorn, they've been baptized, man. I'm going to go to, when I join the church, I'm going to go and join the church then. See? They don't criticize no musician because you're a musician. But the other guy, they want to poke for them, see. I said, listen, now you used to be back there playing pitty-patt and poking and all that, use the preacher. What about that?
Oh, but you mean they object?

But you're a preacher now, but you're going to dominate me because I'm a musician. Now you don't have to be a preacher because you quit gambling, and in the church, I've got to quit playing my music. You have to be a member of your church. I said, uh-uh.
Well, I didn't know that some churches, is that true? That's true. They object to you because you're a musician?

Yeah, they object. See? They don't want you in your church because you're a musician. And a musician ain't no one to walk. So you can, see. I said, you've got a musician and an album. You want another beer?
No problem.
They make an honest living, I mean. Oh, but they, maybe... It's mostly around in the Baptist churches. In the Baptist churches, see. Yeah. Catholic churches.
Now my wife passed, she used to be a toddler player. But he gave up. Yeah.
